mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and mesalamine may increase gentamicin renal accumulation; gentamicin is aminoglycoside with inherent nephrotoxic potential exacerbated by mesalamine-related renal effects.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; maintain adequate hydration and avoid nephrotoxic combinations when feasible.
